title: Define New Plan Data Structure
description: Create or update a centralized data source to define the new subscription plan's attributes, including name, price, and features.
details: Implement a TypeScript module (e.g., `app/lib/plans.ts`) or extend `app/dashboard/data.json` to include the new plan. Ensure the structure includes all necessary fields (plan name, price, feature list, description, and unique identifier). This data source will be used by both the pricing section and sign-up flow. Follow best practices for data organization and export the plan list for easy import.
test_strategy: Write unit tests to verify the data structure exports the correct plan information. Manually inspect that the new plan appears in the exported data and all required fields are present.

title: Build PricingSection and PricingCard Components
description: Develop reusable React components to display all available plans, including the new plan, on the landing page.
details: Create `components/pricing-section.tsx` to map over the plan data and render a `PricingCard` for each plan using shadcn/ui components (e.g., Card, Button). Ensure the new plan is visually distinct and highlights its value proposition. Make the 'Sign Up' button for each plan link to the sign-up page, passing the selected plan as a query parameter or state.
test_strategy: Render the components in Storybook or a test page with mock data. Verify that all plans, including the new one, display correctly and the 'Sign Up' button routes as expected.

title: Integrate PricingSection into Landing Page
description: Add the new PricingSection component to the main landing page to showcase the new plan.
details: Import and embed `<PricingSection />` into `app/page.tsx` at the appropriate location (e.g., after Features or before Testimonials). Ensure the layout remains responsive and visually consistent with the rest of the landing page. Update any relevant metadata or SEO tags if needed.
test_strategy: Manually test the landing page in multiple browsers and device sizes to confirm the new section appears as intended and does not break existing layout.

title: Update Sign-Up Flow for Plan Selection
description: Modify the sign-up page to capture and persist the selected plan during user registration.
details: Update `app/sign-up/page.tsx` to read the selected plan from the query parameter or state (set by the PricingSection's 'Sign Up' button). Add a hidden input or selection UI to ensure the chosen plan is included in the registration payload. Adjust the backend logic (if necessary) to associate the plan with the new user in the database. Ensure compatibility with Better Auth and Drizzle ORM.
test_strategy: Test the sign-up process by selecting different plans from the landing page and verifying that the correct plan is associated with the new user account (check in DB or via dashboard display).

title: Display User Plan in Dashboard
description: Update the user dashboard to display the current user's subscribed plan.
details: Modify `app/dashboard/page.tsx` to fetch and display the user's plan information after login. Use the plan data structure to render plan details (name, features, etc.) in the dashboard UI. Ensure the display is clear and matches the information shown on the landing page.
test_strategy: Sign up with the new plan, log in, and verify the dashboard correctly displays the selected plan. Test with existing users to ensure backward compatibility.
